caption: The drawing features a single metallic bowl positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bowl is rendered in shades of gray, with highlights and reflections suggesting a shiny metal surface. It has a wide rim and a deep, rounded body. Surrounding the bowl, the drawing is bordered by a rectangle that appears to be made of a translucent, slightly yellowed tape, secured at all four corners and along the edges. The tape's texture is uneven and visible, partially overlapping onto the main image area. The overall composition shows only the bowl as the primary object, with no additional items or detailed background elements.
title: Pewter Basin
